name: campaign-brainstorm
description: Dual-mode campaign-planning interview for CCMB graduates. Smart mode reads existing context (CLAUDE.md, voice, MCPs, deps) and asks ~6-8 questions for missing fields. Workshop mode walks 5 framework layers (~15 questions). Produces campaigns/<slug>/brief.md with YAML frontmatter for downstream auto-read. MarTech section is Claude-native — uses installed MCPs/skills, never defaults to paid SaaS.
